summary: E2E regression on FOODbakēd CMS loop (super-admin HomepageManagement -> /food customer render). All 12 review scenarios PASS. Main bug (duplicate section_type collapse + hardcoded order) is confirmed fixed: /food?preview_country=CI now renders hero + BOTH food_promos rows (Best ever + Best Deal/best+fgh) in admin display_order. Backend regression suite test_food_homepage_cms.py: 11/11 PASS.

issues: Minor: hero image slightly overlaps bottom edge of 'Rechercher' CTA button so the label is clipped to 'Reche' at 390px. Hero text 'evryday / nous rassemble' also sits in front of the vegetable image which reduces readability. Non-blocking cosmetic issue, not caused by this CMS change.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminHomepageManagement.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete (line 330) — functional, but switching to a shadcn AlertDialog would be more on-brand with the rest of the app.
Country isolation on admin is clean (IN returns [] both in table and API). Good.
Preview button generates correct /food?preview_country=<cc> URL — verified new-tab open.
food_testimonial section_type correctly whitelisted in /app/backend/core/models/homepage.py and renders bilingual via quote_fr/quote_en/meta_fr/meta_en.
seed_data_creation: Created a test food_testimonial row 'Nos clients' (quote_fr='Super service', quote_en='Great service', meta_fr='5/5 Clients heureux') and DELETED it at end of test — no residual seed data left in CI homepage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FOODbakēd CMS loop fully verified end-to-end on 2026-01-05. Admin UI testids: hp-table, hp-country-select, hp-preview-btn, hp-add-btn, hp-editor-type, hp-editor-enabled, hp-field-<key>, hp-toggle-<id>, hp-up-<id>, hp-down-<id>, hp-edit-<id>, hp-delete-<id>.
